dedupe_keys.name: great east japan earthquake lifeline and infrastructure restoration data cabinet office 2011

description: This Cabinet Office reference material compiles restoration curves and damage figures for lifelines and infrastructure after the 11 March 2011 Tohoku earthquake and tsunami, for the first meeting of the expert committee on earthquake and tsunami countermeasures drawing lessons from the disaster. Over 15 pages it charts electricity restoration in the Tohoku Electric and Tokyo Electric areas, from about 4.5 million households without power on the evening of 11 March, city gas, water supply, sewage treatment, telecommunications and transport restoration, each compared with the 1995 Hanshin-Awaji earthquake, plus damage to municipal offices, liquefaction and stranded commuters in the Tokyo area. It was compiled by the Cabinet Office from utility websites and ministry data, with figures as of early May 2011. The PDF is available free on the Cabinet Office disaster management website; no licence is named. Caveats: it is in Japanese, the curves are charts, not tabular data, and they stop in spring 2011. It supports calibration of multi-lifeline restoration models for earthquake and tsunami recovery; a related record is the Nankai Trough lifeline countermeasures material.
name: Great East Japan Earthquake lifeline and infrastructure restoration data (Cabinet Office, 2011)
